Music in Amsterdam this week

All this week's events

23 – 29 Nov · 26 events

Concerts, live music nights, listening sessions and one-off gigs, from intimate living-room shows to bigger stages. There is something for most tastes, whether you are into jazz, classical, folk, electronic or new bands. The list is refreshed every week, so it is worth checking back. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.
